about: Vama Wovenfab manufactures PP/HDPE woven sacks, bags, fabrics, tarpaulin sheets and loop-handle bags for B2B customers in agriculture, fertilizer, cement, chemicals and food industries, and also trades plastic granules. It operates one plant at Daman (production since 2013) and is headquartered in Mumbai. FY26 revenue was about Rs 214.6 crore, sold in 3 states and 1 union territory.

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for construction of shed
Capital expenditure for purchase of machinery

promoters.background: Promoters describe about 3 decades of experience in the plastics industry; Vaibhav Gupta is CFO and Saurabh Gupta is Managing Director.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 96.84% of FY26 revenue; Customer 1 alone was 63.68% (49.48% in FY25, 36.43% in FY24); top 3 were 89.29%.

litigation_note: Company, promoters and directors face pending criminal, civil and tax proceedings (amounts not quantified in the extracted text). Contingent liabilities (tax and GST demands) were only about Rs 0.29 crore at Mar-26.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 27.9 crore (FY24) to Rs 214.6 crore (FY26), and PAT from Rs 2.6 crore to Rs 11.6 crore.
Reported RoCE of 31.94% and RoNW of 50.37% in FY26, well above the two listed peers' RoNW (1.27% and 11.20%).
ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer with an integrated plant at Daman operating since 2013.
Wide product range: PP/HDPE woven bags, BOPP laminated bags, FIBC fabric, tarpaulin and loop-handle bags.
Serves multiple end-industries such as fertilizer, cement, food grains, sugar and chemicals.
Experienced promoter family with about three decades in the plastics industry.
Pure fresh issue (no offer for sale); Rs 26.5 crore of proceeds earmarked for working capital and Rs 8.6 crore for capex.

risks.title: Extreme customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers were 96.84% of FY26 revenue and a single customer 63.68%. Loss or repricing by one buyer would hit revenue sharply.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 6.31 crore in FY26 and Rs 2.33 crore in FY25, as profit is absorbed by inventory and receivables.

risks.title: Heavy working capital needs and rising debt
risks.detail: Borrowings rose from Rs 11.17 crore (FY24) to Rs 25.44 crore (FY26), mostly short-term; inventories were Rs 44.78 crore and receivables Rs 18.42 crore at Mar-26.

risks.title: Falling margins despite fast growth
risks.detail: EBITDA margin fell from 18.32% (FY24) to 8.32% (FY26) and PAT margin from 9.44% to 5.38%, with revenue up about 7.7 times, partly from low-margin trading of granules.

risks.title: Pending litigation involving company, promoters and directors
risks.detail: Criminal, civil and tax proceedings are pending against the company, promoters and directors; an adverse outcome could bring penalties.

risks.title: Regulatory and statutory non-compliances
risks.detail: Delays in depositing GST, TDS and EPF/ESIC, past ROC filing errors (e.g. PAS-3), and delayed renewal of pollution Consent to Operate/Establish in Daman.

risks.title: Capex not yet ordered and promoter guarantees
risks.detail: No orders yet placed for shed construction and machinery (Rs 8.6 crore planned); promoters have given personal guarantees for company loans, and lenders hold charge over assets.

risks.title: Single-plant and regional concentration; commodity product
risks.detail: Only one plant (Daman) and revenue from 3 states plus 1 UT; woven sacks are price-sensitive and face substitutes like paper and jute bags.

notes: Restated standalone financials in Rs lakh converted to Rs crore; FY24-FY26 (Mar year-end), audited by B. M. Gattani & Co.
